faqs.question: How is a project priced — fixed price or time and materials?
faqs.answer: Both, depending on how well-defined the work is. A clearly scoped deliverable (a rebuild, a defined integration, a security audit) is usually fixed price, agreed after a short discovery phase. Ongoing product development or an embedded team works better as time and materials with a monthly cap. We'll recommend one during the first call and explain the trade-offs — we don't lock you into a model that doesn't fit.

faqs.question: How long does a typical engagement take?
faqs.answer: A focused project (an audit, an MVP, a single integration) usually runs 6–10 weeks. Larger builds — ERP rollouts, platform rebuilds, multi-phase migrations — typically run 4–9 months, delivered in two-week cycles so you have a working build in hand from sprint one rather than waiting until the end.

faqs.question: We already have an in-house engineering team — can you still help?
faqs.answer: Yes, this is a large part of what we do. We slot in as an extension of an existing team for a specific gap — a cloud migration, a security review, extra capacity during a crunch — reporting into your process rather than replacing it. See IT Outsourcing under Services.

faqs.question: Do you work with early-stage companies, or only larger organizations?
faqs.answer: Both. Startups typically come to us for a first product build or to harden something built quickly pre-funding; larger organizations more often bring ERP, data, or security work. Pricing and process adjust to the size of the engagement either way.

faqs.question: Who owns the code and IP once the project ships?
faqs.answer: You do. Every engagement is covered by an NDA before any details are shared, and the contract assigns IP in the deliverables to you on final payment — there's no vendor lock-in to us specifically.

faqs.question: Where is DivSphere based, and do you work with clients outside Pakistan?
faqs.answer: We're headquartered in Karachi, Pakistan, and deliver for clients across South Asia, the Gulf, and beyond — remotely, with overlap hours agreed up front for standups and reviews. Enquiries get a response within one business day.

ctaBand.heading: Have a system that needs building — or fixing?
ctaBand.body: Tell us where it's breaking down. We'll respond within one business day with next steps.
